# Design: Crypto Hunt

## Visual direction

- **Purpose:** a live treasure hunt across a real venue. Three surfaces with different jobs:
  - **Player:** walking, often outdoors in daylight, one hand. Big targets, one action per screen, high contrast on parchment.
  - **Admin:** a captain's chart table. Dense, scannable, every team visible at once.
  - **Screen:** stage spectacle, readable from the back of a hall (minimum text 48 px at 1080p).
- **Tone:** "ancient treasure map" (D-021). Aged parchment, iron-gall ink, wax seals, brass compass, candlelight.
- **Memorable detail:**
  - The **map with fog** is the signature: it starts blank and inks itself in as the team progresses.
  - The **realistic 3D treasure chest** (Blender, PBR) opens for the winners, on their phones and on the projector.
- **Anti-patterns:** cartoon pirates, purple gradients, generic glassmorphism, emoji-heavy UI, stock photos, fake "AI" glow.

## Component principles

- Every player screen shows **one primary state** in big type: "SOLVE", "SEEK THE MARK", "CHECK IN 3/4", "PENALTY 1:42", "ELIMINATED".
- Torn-edge parchment panels with ink borders; wax-seal buttons for primary actions; brass for secondary.
- **Admin:** control bar pinned on top (only valid actions enabled); team grid as the main view; timeline + alerts in a side rail.
- Content states for every data view:

| State | Trigger | Feedback | Next action |
|---|---|---|---|
| Loading | First fetch / reconnect | Ink-drawing skeleton + "Unrolling the map…" | Automatic |
| Empty | No teams, locations or questions | One sentence explaining why | Primary button (Create teams / Add location / Import questions) |
| Error | RPC error code | Friendly message mapped from the code, in the theme's voice | Retry or what to do |
| Partial | Realtime disconnected | "Reconnecting…" seal, last data dimmed | Automatic resync |

## Typography

| Role | Font | Use |
|---|---|---|
| Display | IM Fell English SC | Titles, round splashes, projector |
| Body | Spectral | Questions, clues, UI text (legible at 16 px in sunlight) |
| Codes | IBM Plex Mono | Team codes, secret keys, admin tables |

## Color

| Token | Value | Use |
|---|---|---|
| `--parchment` | #EADBB8 | Page background (light, sunlight-readable) |
| `--parchment-deep` | #D9C394 | Panels, map base |
| `--ink` | #2A1D12 | Text (contrast ≥ 10:1 on parchment) |
| `--sepia` | #6E4A2A | Secondary text, borders |
| `--wax` | #8E1B1B | Primary actions, alerts, elimination |
| `--gold` | #B88A1E | Progress, winners |
| `--sea` | #2F5D62 | Map water, info |
| `--moss` | #4B6B3A | Success / checked in |
| `--night` | #12100D | Projector background (candle-lit chart table) |

The player app stays light (outdoor glare). The projector uses `--night` with the lit map.

## Spacing

4 px base; 8 / 12 / 16 / 24 / 32 / 48. 16 px side gutter on phones. Touch targets ≥ 48 px.

## Responsive rules

- `/play`: 360–430 px first; single column; scanner full-bleed.
- `/play` on a laptop or desktop: **the same screens, not a second design.** The phone column (max 440 px) sits centred on the dark chart-table background with a small header (crew, round); nothing stretches, and the scanner uses the webcam inside the same frame. See *Desktop · Sealed mark*.
- `/admin`: ≥ 1280 px; team grid auto-fills; usable down to 1024 px.
- `/screen`: 1920×1080 fixed scale.

## Interaction

- Scanner opens straight from the primary button; vibration + ink-splash on a good scan.
- Key entry: 6 large boxes, auto-advance, paste allowed, ambiguous characters (0/O, 1/I) not used.
- Destructive admin actions use a typed confirm.

## Accessibility

- Contrast ≥ 4.5:1 everywhere (ink on parchment far exceeds it).
- All state changes announced via `aria-live`.
- Reduced motion: no fog animation, no chest animation (static open chest image).

## Motion

| Moment | Motion |
|---|---|
| Clue piece unlocked | Ink writes the piece in (stroke reveal, 600 ms) |
| All pieces → seek | Fog burns away over the region, compass needle swings |
| Check-in | Wax seal stamps onto the member's slot |
| Round complete | Map scroll rolls up / unrolls the next round |
| Prank | Gold confetti → freeze → torn parchment "FOOLED!" |
| Eliminated | Map chars at the edges and fades |
| Finale | Realistic 3D chest: lid opens, god rays, coins spill; rank + completion key |
| Projector leaderboard | Rows reorder with FLIP spring animation; ships sail between map marks |

Built (P3): each screen is a component in `src/components/player/screens/` (Join, Lobby, Solve, Seek, CheckIn — also the Final mark, Penalty, Results — Prank and Sealed, Endings — Eliminated, Spectator, Game over, Hunt over, Victory). `/dev/screens?s=<name>` renders each with the mockups' sample data in development, and `npm run screens` screenshots them for side-by-side checks.

Notes:
- Team names, members, venue places, questions and times in the mockups are sample data.
- The venue map is a drawn placeholder until the real venue map is supplied.
- Admin and projector use a dark chart-table surface; player gameplay screens stay light. Prank, Eliminated and Victory use dark grounds for drama.

## Reference sources

- Antique cartography (17th-century sea charts) for line work and compass roses.
- AI Musical Chair's realistic-3D pipeline (Blender PBR → baked WebP textures → GLB < 1.5 MB).
